description: Read the gimbal's current absolute yaw/pitch in degrees (positive yaw = camera's left, positive pitch = down) via the standard UVC Pan/Tilt controls. This is a live hardware readout accurate to ±1°, reported rounded to 2 decimal places (finer digits would be noise, not precision): it is valid during a move as well as after one, and reflects motion the host did not command (speed moves, recenter, tracking).
name: obsbot_gimbal_position
